name: Chippubetsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chippubetsu town emblem in blue and yellow: a stylised mountain shape above a yellow device.
history: Municipal flag of Chippubetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 June 1968.

features.role: Chippubetsu town emblem — a stylised mountain shape above a yellow device
